$comment: The .devflow.toml schema version this skill operates under. Vendored with the skill, so a consumer's own checkout carries the requirement its pinned skills actually impose. scripts/consumer-pin-audit.sh takes the highest policy_schema_version declared by any vendored skill and refuses a repository whose .devflow.toml is an older shape; a pre-Dev-flow-v2 skill ships no such file, which is how an unadvanced pin correctly reads as requiring nothing. Declared per skill rather than once centrally because a consumer vendors skills individually and may hold any subset of them.
